description: Scrape any web page to clean markdown. A keyless web scraper that converts a single URL into LLM-ready markdown plus structured metadata (title, headings, links, word count), so an agent can read a page without running a browser. A per-call alternative to Firecrawl's scrape endpoint, with no API key and no account. Single page per call, not a site crawler. [$0.03/call]. Params — url: page URL to scrape; maxChars: markdown cap Example params: {'url': 'https://example.com'}
name: scrape
